news.headline: US-Iran Military Escalation — Brent Crude Spikes to $97.73, Near $100 Mark
news.what_happened: The US and Iran exchanged strikes over the weekend, with Saudi Aramco facilities reportedly hit in fresh attacks. Oil prices rose to a 6-week high on Monday with Brent at $97.73/bbl (+1.5%). Goldman Sachs sees $120 as a risk scenario.
news.why_it_matters: Rising crude inflates India's import bill, widens the current account deficit, pressures the rupee, and fuels inflation. Broad negative for India macro but a direct earnings tailwind for upstream oil producers (ONGC, OIL) and cost headwind for airlines, paints, tyres and logistics.

news.headline: Hot US Payrolls Reignite Fed Rate Hike Fears — Dow -0.51%, S&P -0.38%, Nasdaq -0.29%
news.what_happened: Stronger-than-expected US August payrolls pushed Dow to 53,414 (-0.51%), S&P 500 to 7,718.60 (-0.38%), Nasdaq to 26,506 (-0.29%) on Friday Sept 4. US 10Y yield hit 4.79%, highest since Nov 2023.
news.why_it_matters: Higher US rates strengthen the dollar and trigger FII outflows from EMs including India. Elevated yields pressure rate-sensitive sectors globally and reduce risk appetite for India equities.

news.headline: FII Net Sellers ₹3,111.90 Cr Friday — DII Absorbs with ₹8,930 Cr Buying
news.what_happened: FIIs sold ₹3,111.90 Cr net in cash segment on September 4. Domestic institutions (LIC, MFs) bought ₹8,930.10 Cr, limiting the fall. Nifty 50 still closed at 23,779, down 0.50%.
news.why_it_matters: Sustained FII selling signals global risk-off for Indian equities. While DII buying provides support, continued outflows could pressure mid-small caps. Today's FII data will be the key directional cue.

news.headline: Gold at $4,425/oz — Risk-Off Rally Lifts Gold Loan NBFC Collateral Values
news.what_happened: Gold held near $4,425/oz as US-Iran geopolitical tensions drove safe-haven demand. Silver at $65.55/oz. Precious metals broadly in risk-off mode.
news.why_it_matters: Gold loan NBFCs (Muthoot Finance, Manappuram) see AUM quality improve as LTV ratios fall when gold prices rise. Higher collateral enables disbursement growth and reduces NPA risk. Direct positive P&L impact.

news.headline: Nikkei +2.12% on OpenAI Memory Chip Demand — Asian Tech Rallies
news.what_happened: Japan's Nikkei 225 surged 2.12% to 66,399.84 on Monday as tech stocks rallied on new OpenAI model news expected to drive memory chip demand. Hang Seng was -0.15%, CSI 300 +0.44%.
news.why_it_matters: Asian tech optimism is a mild sentiment positive for Indian IT, but the impact is limited as the rupee barely moved (-0.07%) and Nasdaq fell 0.29% on Friday. Not a strong enough signal for IT sector outperformance today.

picks.catalyst: Brent Crude +1.5% to $97.73 on US-Iran military escalation; Saudi Aramco facilities struck
picks.logic: ONGC's realization directly tracks Brent crude. Every $5/bbl rise adds ~₹2,500-3,000 Cr to annual EBITDA. With Iran-Saudi conflict escalating and Goldman projecting $120 as a risk scenario, ONGC is the clearest direct beneficiary today. The stock closed at ₹233.19 with strong volume expected at open.

picks.catalyst: Gold at $4,425/oz; US-Iran geopolitical risk-off drives safe-haven demand
picks.logic: Muthoot Finance is India's largest gold loan NBFC. Rising gold prices lower effective LTV on the existing book (reducing NPA risk), enable fresh disbursements at higher ticket sizes, and attract gold pledging. On a broad risk-off day, gold NBFCs tend to outperform as they combine defensive quality with a positive commodity catalyst. Stock at ₹2,885 vs 52-week high of ₹4,149 — undervalued on current gold price.
